name: dsh-vim
description: Vim-style keyboard scrolling (d = down, e = up) for whichever pane the pointer is over — the conversation or the sidebar — a message box that never takes focus on its own, a choice of what a bare Enter does in the composer (sends, breaks the line, does nothing, or sends on a double Enter — Ctrl/Cmd+Enter always sends), a stepper for the reasoning level (q), a picker for the model you pick yourself (w: a small window listing each model with all of its reasoning levels, d / e between models, Tab between levels, w again to switch), plus a task window (f) that lists recent conversations with their live state and a stage you can mark, renames one with r, archives one with g, and jumps to the selected one when you press f again
